justification: Mayfield's Out, I saw it, I'm not an idiot, don't print that I didn't see it. I'm not doing what I did in Week 2, I'm not getting cute with the quarterback room again — Geno goes in because I paid for him specifically, Brissett behind him, Pierce out the door, a man who's been to zero quarterbacks does not go back to zero quarterbacks, that's a PRINCIPLE, not a panic move. And no, I'm not flipping it to Herbert out of spite just because he's sitting there looking smug on my bench — that's exactly the kind of higher-number tell that got me burned two weeks ago, I'm not falling for my own trick twice. Collins stays benched, he's bad luck, he owes me two weeks and he's not getting out early no matter what his projection says today. DJ Moore's Questionable but he's not MY Questionable guy with a history against me, so he plays, and if that blows up in my face that's a conversation for next week's me. Everybody else stays exactly where they were because changing things I don't have to change is how I lost 55-119 in the first place.
